  {"step":2,"file":"glib/fuzzing/fuzz_date_time_new_from_iso8601.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":9,"var":"nul_terminated_data","code":"g_date_time_new_from_iso8601 ((const gchar *) nul_terminated_data, NULL)","note":"The fuzz target passes the attacker string directly into the ISO-8601 parser with no default timezone fallback."},
  {"step":3,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"g_date_time_new_from_iso8601","line":1498,"var":"text","code":"for (length = 0; text[length] != '\\0'; length++) { if (date_length < 0 && (text[length] == 'T' || text[length] == 't' || text[length] == ' ')) date_length = length; }","note":"The parser scans the whole input to split date and time at the first separator, so malformed prefixes still influence later parsing decisions."},
  {"step":4,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"g_date_time_new_from_iso8601","line":1505,"var":"text + date_length + 1","code":"parse_iso8601_time (text + date_length + 1, length - (date_length + 1), &hour, &minute, &seconds, &tz)","note":"The time suffix is parsed separately; timezone parsing can accept a trailing offset or Z and returns a GTimeZone object."},
  {"step":5,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"parse_iso8601_timezone","line":1360,"var":"text[length - 1] / text[i]","code":"if (length > 0 && text[length - 1] == 'Z') ... for (i = length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (text[i] == '+' || text[i] == '-')","note":"The timezone parser walks backward to locate an offset marker, which is the key propagation point for inputs that embed a timezone suffix."},
  {"step":6,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"parse_iso8601_date","line":1260,"var":"text,length","code":"YYYY-MM-DD / YYYYMMDD / YYYY-DDD / YYYYWwwD dispatch","note":"After time parsing succeeds, the date parser dispatches on the date layout and converts the attacker-controlled fields into year/month/day values."},
  {"step":7,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"g_date_time_new","line":1040,"var":"year,month,day,hour,minute,seconds","code":"datetime = g_date_time_alloc (tz); ... datetime->days = ymd_to_days (year, month, day); datetime->usec = ...","note":"The parsed components are materialized into a heap-allocated GDateTime object, establishing the object later used by the formatter."},
  {"step":8,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"g_date_time_format_iso8601","line":3488,"var":"datetime->usec","code":"if (datetime->usec % G_TIME_SPAN_SECOND != 0) format = \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f\";","note":"The formatter branches on the stored microseconds and may emit a fractional-second representation derived from the parsed input."},
  {"step":9,"file":"glib/gdatetime.c","function":"g_date_time_format_iso8601","line":3495,"var":"datetime","code":"main_date = g_date_time_format (datetime, format); outstr = g_string_new (main_date);","note":"The final sink formats the parsed date/time into a newly allocated string; the vulnerable target then exercises this path on attacker-controlled data."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
